personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (with athletic modern typography)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply contrasted $200/month visual system where the coach's custom brand color and rich imagery shine through frosted glass.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic padding. Cards never flush to screen edges (always md/lg margins). Whitespace creates the luxury feel.

do's: Hero cards overlay (frosted glass over photo backgrounds).
Pinned filter rows / layout toggle segmented controls.
dont's: Form fields or body text regions.
When underlying content lacks contrast (ensure translucent tinted base).

screens.name: Coach Home
screens.purpose: A customizable, reorderable dashboard for triage and quick stats.

states.loading: Skeleton grids mapping to the widget layouts.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty dashboard + 'Customize your home' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard metrics with retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Reorderable sections (Widgets). Use surfaceSecondary for widget cards, with md radius. A 'Customize Home' bottom sheet allows toggling visibility and dragging to reorder sections. No practitioner terminology.

screens.name: Programs Library
screens.purpose: Visual showcase of the coach's 61 programs (Yoga, Fitness, Breathwork, etc.).

states.empty: No programs created. CTA to 'Build your first program'.
states.error: Unable to fetch programs, retry button.

screens.layout: Grid of large hero cards. Each card uses a background image (expo-image) with a vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) at the bottom. Title and metadata in the bottom 30%. Safe thumb zone spacing.

screens.name: Program Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific program with 3 distinct, seamless layout views.

states.loading: Skeleton for hero image and list below.
states.empty: No sessions in this program. CTA to 'Add Session'.

screens.layout: Top half: Cinematic hero cover image with a glass back-button header. Middle: Sticky glass segmented control (Week, List, Calendar). Week-grid: horizontal scroll views per week containing frosted session cards. List: vertical chronological stack with clear section headers. Calendar: a date-based grid with dots for active sessions and a bottom sheet previewing the selected day's blocks.

screens.name: Session Editor (Builder)
screens.purpose: Block-based editor for exercises, sets, reps, and notes.

states.empty: Empty canvas. 'Add Block' or 'Add Rest Day'.
states.error: Failed to save block, retry action.

screens.layout: Vertical stack of blocks. Each block is a surfaceSecondary card. Inputs for sets/reps inside. Rest/notes blocks use surfaceTertiary with an info/clock icon. A sticky primary CTA 'Save Session' rests in a glass container at the bottom.

screens.name: Client Today (Player)
screens.purpose: High-end session execution flow for the client.
screens.layout: Massive typography for current block. High-contrast controls. Swipeable horizontal pager or vertical list of exercise blocks. Distinct styling for 'Form Notes' and 'Purpose Notes' using brandTertiary tinted containers. Sticky 'Complete Workout' button.

screens.name: Coach Inbox & Chat
screens.purpose: Review daily check-ins and message clients directly.
screens.layout: List layout for inbox. Tapping a check-in opens a full-screen view with an 'Inline Reply' text input anchored to the keyboard (KeyboardAvoidingView). Chat uses surfaceSecondary for received bubbles, brandPrimary for sent.

screens.name: Brand Studio
screens.purpose: Where the coach customizes the client-facing look.
screens.layout: List of configuration blocks: Logo upload (image selector), Color picker (updates brandPrimary context globally), and Cover Images defaults. Preview section showing a mocked 'Client Today' card with the new tokens applied instantly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality. Do NOT invert to a standard light mode unless specifically building a theme-switcher. The dark base (#0a0a0a) makes the customizable Brand Studio colors pop and gives the $200/month luxury feel.
BANNED WORD: 'Practitioner'. Strictly ensure this word is absent from all UI, schemas, and dynamic vocabularies.

BRAND STUDIO PROPAGATION: Use a React Context or global state for `brandPrimary`. Apply this color to active tab indicators, primary CTAs, and subtle gradients (e.g., brandTertiary). The base UI must remain monochrome dark so ANY brand color the coach picks looks stunning.

PROGRAM LAYOUT VIEWS: Build a segmented control (frosted glass background) inside the Program Detail screen to toggle between Week-grid (horizontal ScrollView), List (vertical Stack), and Calendar (date grid with BottomSheet). Maintain scroll position or transition seamlessly when toggling.

IMAGE SCRIMS: Every program cover image or hero banner MUST have an absolute positioned `expo-linear-gradient` scrim (transparent at top, 80% surfaceInverse at bottom) behind text. This is a non-negotiable rule for readability.
TYPOGRAPHY: Cap weight at 500. Use Satoshi. Size dictates hierarchy. Large cinematic headings (2xl/3xl) for the Client Today player and Program details.

STICKY CTAs: Every screen with a primary action (e.g., 'Save Session' in Builder, 'Complete Workout' in Player) must have the button anchored to the bottom inside a safe-area glass container, above the scroll view.
